raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8 is no longer a tracked model, so its dedicated MLA W8A8 and MLA HiCache test cases are removed. Their FIA (fused inference attention) and HiCache dimensions are now covered by a single Moonlight-16B-A3B bf16 case on 2 NPUs. The DP attention cases that shared the same removed weights move to Moonlight as well, which lets them be re-enabled.

## Modifications

- Remove `test/registered/npu/basic_function/runtime_opts/test_npu_mla_w8a8int8.py`, `test/registered/npu/basic_function/runtime_opts/test_npu_mla_fia_w8a8int8.py` and `test/registered/npu/basic_function/HiCache/test_npu_hicache_mla.py`.
- Add `test/registered/npu/basic_function/runtime_opts/test_npu_mla_fia_hicache_bf16.py`: covers the FIA (`ASCEND_USE_FIA`) and HiCache (hierarchical cache) paths with the bf16 Moonlight-16B-A3B model on 2 NPUs, replacing the removed W8A8 coverage.
  - Registers to `base-b-test-2-npu-a3` (PR) and `nightly-2-npu-a3` (nightly, est_time 1400).
  - Drives GSM8K through `NPUGSM8KMixin`: the PR pipeline only sends the smoke request, the nightly pipeline runs the full 1319-question set with a 0.83 threshold.
  - Keeps expandable pinned host segments (`PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF`) because HiCache reserves several GB of host memory per rank.
  - Detects the invoking pipeline via `GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF`, because the nightly workflow is also path-triggered by pull requests, so the nightly path still runs the full GSM8K evaluation.
- `test/registered/npu/basic_function/dp_attn/test_npu_dp_attention.py`: use `MOONLIGHT_16B_A3B_MODEL_PATH` instead of the removed W8A8 weights in `TestDPAttentionMixedChunk` and `TestDPRetract`, re-enable the former, and set the GSM8K threshold to 0.83 (Moonlight bf16 baseline is ~0.837).

## Accuracy Tests

N/A - CI test-case registration only; no model or kernel behavior change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+import os
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ascend.e2e.test_npu_performance_utils import (
+    MOONLIGHT_16B_A3B_MODEL_PATH,
+)
+from sglang.test.ascend.npu_eval_accuracy_kit import NPUGSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(
+    est_time=800,
+    suite="base-b-test-2-npu-a3",
+)
+register_npu_ci(est_time=1400, suite="nightly-2-npu-a3", nightly=True)
+
+# The nightly pipeline is also triggered by pull requests via path filters, so the
+# pipeline is identified by GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF (inherited from the caller's github
+# context) instead of the triggering event.
+_is_pr_pipeline = "/.github/workflows/nightly-test-npu.yml" not in os.environ.get(
+    "GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF", ""
+)
+
+
+class TestAscendMlaFiaHicacheBf16(CustomTestCase, NPUGSM8KMixin):
+    # The nightly pipeline runs the full GSM8K set to avoid sampling variance; the
+    # PR pipeline only runs the mixin smoke request.
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.83
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        os.environ["ASCEND_USE_FIA"] = "true"
+        cls.model = MOONLIGHT_16B_A3B_MODEL_PATH
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        other_args = [
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            0.8,
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "ascend",
+            "--device",
+            "npu",
+            "--dtype",
+            "bfloat16",
+            "--tp-size",
+            2,
+            "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+            "--hicache-size",
+            2 if _is_pr_pipeline else 10,
+        ]
+        # The PR pipeline runs eager to shorten startup; the nightly pipeline
+        # covers the default decode graph path with FIA + HiCache.
+        if _is_pr_pipeline:
+            other_args.append("--disable-cuda-graph")
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            env={
+                **os.environ,
+                "PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF": (
+                    "expandable_segments:True,pin_memory_expandable_segments:True"
+                ),
+            },
+            other_args=other_args,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        terminate_and_kill_process_tree(cls.process)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
